# Dallas Detox Center

> Dallas Detox Center is a licensed residential addiction and mental health treatment center serving Dallas–Fort Worth and North Texas from a private 32-bed campus in Weatherford, Texas.

Programs: medical detox, residential inpatient, mental health residential, dual diagnosis and aftercare planning. Address: 100 Mariah Drive, Weatherford, TX 76087. Phone: 817-904-2197. Admissions are available 24/7.

All URLs below are canonical. Medical content is reviewed under the editorial policy at https://dallasdetoxcenter.com/editorial-policy.
